channel.title: Guides | Toolbox
channel.description: Plain-English guides to Korean severance pay, Korean age, and Korean versus WHO BMI categories, based on official sources.

item.title: How severance pay works in Korea
item.description: How Korean severance pay works: who is eligible, the official formula, how average wage is calculated, and when it must be paid.

item.title: Korean age explained
item.description: How Korean age works, why Korea switched to international age in 2023, and where year age is still used, such as buying alcohol and tobacco.

item.title: Korean vs WHO BMI categories
item.description: Why a BMI of 24 is normal under WHO categories but pre-obese in Korea. Compare the two scales and the research behind lower Asian cut-offs.
